_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
The test shrinks the app's tail-first mounting so that a 15-turn conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} spans many chunks: on load only the last few chunks mount (as ".messages-chunk" elements) and older history renders as placeholders ([data-testid="pending-chunk"]). "The counts" are pending = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="pending-chunk"]').length and mounted = document.querySelectorAll('.messages-chunk').length. "The gap" is the messages container's (".messages-container") scrollHeight - scrollTop - clientHeight. To "open the conversation", navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}, wait for the message input ([data-testid="message-input"]) to be visible (allow 30s), then wait until the LAST element matching [data-testid="message"] is visible (its getBoundingClientRect() has a non-zero width and height; allow 30s). The test has already set the shelley.tailFirstTest knob; do not set it yourself. Check every assertion with an eval that has "expect" (or an assert_* or wait_* step): an eval without "expect" asserts nothing. Wait with such steps and a timeout, not with polling loops inside the expression. When a step says to record something, do it in one eval without "expect" that stores it in the named window variable, then check that variable in a separate eval with "expect". Perform the steps in order. Scrolling up reveals placeholders so none is left in the viewport; the background sweep is off.
1. Open the conversation.
2. Record the counts: window.__before = {pending, mounted}. window.__before.pending must be greater than 0.
3. Scroll to the top of the transcript: eval document.querySelector(".messages-container").scrollTo({top: 0, behavior: "instant"}).
4. Wait until mounted is greater than window.__before.mounted (allow 15s): the placeholders that entered the scrollport hydrate into real content.
5. Wait until no placeholder intersects the messages container (allow 15s): the number of [data-testid="pending-chunk"] elements whose getBoundingClientRect() has bottom > the container rect's top and top < the container rect's bottom must be exactly 0 (no blank band where the user is looking).

steps.expression: new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const check = () => { const els = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="message"]'); const last = els[els.length - 1]; if (!last) { setTimeout(check, 200); return; } const r = last.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width > 0 && r.height > 0) { resolve('true'); } else { setTimeout(check, 200); } }; check(); setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Last message not visible after 30s')), 30000); })

(() => { const container = document.querySelector('.messages-container'); const cr = container.getBoundingClientRect(); const chunks = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="pending-chunk"]'); let intersecting = 0; for (const c of chunks) { const r = c.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.bottom > cr.top && r.top < cr.bottom) intersecting++; } return intersecting; })()
